propositions: Duplicate gate+suite command sets in test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must be consolidated into a single reusable workflow to eliminate hand-copy drift risk.

A new reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml must parameterize checkout by gerrit-refspec/gerrit-project/gerrit-url (branch-head or patchset) and define three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) mirroring test.yml's decomposition.

test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must both delegate to _build-and-test.yml; gerrit-verify's single reusable-call job replaces the monolithic build-and-test, moving lint/typecheck/config-check out of the matrix so they run once.

Five test_ci_workflow_parity.py functions must be rewritten: three safety invariants (verified-gate-runs, script-gating, precommit-skips) retargeted at the reusable; two copy-sync checks converted to delegation+content checks; optionality contract test unchanged.
test_workflow_names.py must be updated to cover _build-and-test.yml with the mapping '_build-and-test.yml' -> 'Build and Test (reusable)'.
